title: KVFetch: Temporal Prefetching for the Missing Half of KV Cache Compression
summary: KV缓存压缩会丢失序列后半段（代码补全、字段值等逐字复制任务），KVFetch用时间预取通道弥补这一根本缺陷， verbatim copying 从 0.8 飙升到 78.4，且无需训练、即插即用
body:
KV缓存压缩会丢失序列后半段（代码补全、字段值等逐字复制任务），KVFetch用时间预取通道弥补这一根本缺陷， verbatim copying 从 0.8 飙升到 78.4，且无需训练、即插即用

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08811
summary_en: This note describes KVFetch, a temporal prefetching channel addressing a fundamental flaw in KV cache compression: the loss of a sequence's second half, which harms verbatim copying tasks such as code completion and field-value extraction. Verbatim copying reportedly surges from 0.8 to 78.4, with no training required and plug-and-play integration. The note is an auto-tagged draft citing an arXiv source, with figures unverified.
